text:
talia: Heads-up — we're doing a linked carousel + X stitch for the small launch next Wed. Thinking 6-card LinkedIn carousel at 09:30, X main thread at 09:15, then a short follow-up at 15:00 focused on customer quotes. Need asset owners and routing for inbound demo requests.
noah: I can assemble the carousel. need final hero still (transparent bg) and two quote cards. filenames I'll output: spark-carousel-6up.pdf, hero-trans.png, quote-anya.png, quote-reece.png
talia: perfect. can you export the carousel as PNGs + one PDF? li prefers 1200x1200 cards.
noah: will do PNGs at 1200x1200 + single PDF. ETA tomorrow noon.
reece: copy plan: X thread -> 5 posts: teaser, benchmark stat, product insight, customer quote, CTA. For LinkedIn card 2 we'll use the heatmap bench image. A/B test tweet 2 copy (data vs narrative).
anya: I'll mock the heatmap: bench-heatmap.png. Also quick ask: can the X follow-up auto-DM new followers with webinar link? Ops-bot, is that allowed?
ops-bot: auto-DM must follow platform rules. We have a template: `/autodm enable template=launch_followup campaign=riff_carousel`. Confirmed for X team account.
leads-bot: routing rule suggestion: campaign=riff_carousel + utm_campaign=riff23 -> send to pipeline: marketing-engage. If `lead_score` >= 85 then escalate to `sales-demo`. Include `referrer` label (x or li).
talia: good. Reece, let's do copy variants: Variant 1 (data-first): "32% lower token cost at same latency." Variant 2 (story-first): "We helped a streaming app cut inference spend." Keep tweet length < 220 chars w/ short link.
reece: got it. I'll draft both and post here for review by 16:00.
noah: small production note: carousel fonts need to be embedded. using Inter var, will rasterize.
talia: engagement plan — replies asking about benchmarks -> auto reply with short case study PDF + link. ops-bot, can we attach file via webhook?
ops-bot: yes. webhook payload supports `attachments[]` as URLs. Example: `{"email":"...","utm":"...","attachments": ["https://cdn.redwood/benchcase.pdf"]}`. leads-bot will tag and route accordingly.
leads-bot: test routed ok. sample: lead_score=90, utm=riff23, referrer=x -> queue sales-demo.
noah: uploaded draft PNGs to drive: https://drive.redwood/launch/riff_carousel_drafts. Please review image 2 (heatmap) and 5 (quote) closely.
talia: scheduling: X thread 09:15 (stitch with influencer tweet at 09:10), LinkedIn 09:30 carousel, follow-up 15:00. Anyone object to 15:00 follow-up? less noise but decent engagement window.
reece: 15:00 fine. Also plan a pinned reply on X with registration link and a short TL;DR.
anya: registration url: https://redwood.ai/riff-live?utm_source=organic&utm_campaign=riff23. Add `utm_referrer` param in webhook.
talia: last checklist: final PNGs + PDF by tomorrow 12:00, copy locked by 16:00, webhook rules confirmed by ops by 18:00, schedule go/no-go by 20:00. If blockers surface, flag here.
noah: will ping when uploads complete. thanks team :sparkles:
